name: What evidence is important in a serious head injury case?

mainEntity.name: What evidence is important in a serious head injury case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Crucial evidence in a serious head injury case includes detailed medical records, such as emergency room reports, diagnostic imaging (MRI, CT scans), treatment plans, and prognoses from neurologists or other specialists. Accident reports, witness statements, photographs or videos of the accident scene, and proof of lost income are also vital. An attorney will also gather expert testimony from medical professionals and accident reconstructionists to support your claim for damages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key evidence in head injury cases includes medical records, imaging scans, accident reports, witness statements, and expert testimony to prove damages.
